title: Cofold -> MM-GBSA plan for v2 sequences (trusted round-1 scorer path)

stage1_cofold.method: boltz predict (Boltz-2), cyclic bond on the peptide chain
stage1_cofold.install: conda py3.11 + conda-forge numpy/scipy; pip install boltz cuequivariance-torch (per refold_rerank_driver.sh, tested)
stage1_cofold.output: complex CIF/PDB (R + P chains) + confidence_*.json (complex_iptm) per peptide
stage1_cofold.caveat: peptide folded as L-backbone (D-Pro/N-methyl not expressible in Boltz sequence field) — same approx as round-1 canonical seqs; iptm is a confidence proxy, NOT the ranking

stage2_mmgbsa.method: peptide_mmgbsa_run.sh (5o45) / peptide_mmgbsa_pocket_run.sh + avb6_pocket_truncate.py (9xmm); OpenMM GBn2 CHARMM36m single-traj, EC2 GPU spot
stage2_mmgbsa.output: dG per peptide on the round-1 scale (pdl1 round-1: -24.97..-53.47)
stage2_mmgbsa.launcher: launch_mmgbsa_pool.sh with DESIGNS_S3 = stage-1 cofold complexes

order: PD-L1/5o45 FIRST (tractable; the target where physics does the selection), then avb6/9xmm (pocket-truncated)
discipline: NEW launcher -> DRY_RUN first (1 peptide, 1 target) per repo convention; confirm cofold produces a 2-chain complex + MM-GBSA parses it BEFORE the full set
status: inputs staged; cofold launcher NOT yet written (new GPU infra); awaiting go to build + dry-run
